cond_0001.intro:
We are seeking an experienced Senior Lab Manager to join the team of Dr. Catherine Dulac at [Location masked].
The Dulac lab focuses on transcriptional, genetic, and optical approaches to explore the molecular and neuronal basis of instinctive social and sickness behaviors in the mouse. More information about the team and their research can be found at: https://www.dulaclab.com/
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Manage day-to-day activities within the laboratory; assure effective operation and maintenance of equipment; obtain and ensure adequate supplies for experimental needs; maintain compliance with all policies and regulations, ensure optimal organization of lab space, contributing to a safe and efficient working environment for all members.

Maintain inventories of lab equipment and scientific materials (i.e., probes, antibodies, etc.).
Establish and maintain online documentation system for protocols and equipment manuals/SOPs.

Act as Lab Safety Officer, liaising with [Location masked] Environmental Health & Safety to maintain a safe working environment in the laboratory.
Train incoming personnel in proper lab conduct and may provide instruction regarding experimental protocols. Develop instructional material for routine training purposes.
Maintain lab website.
May plan for and provide working supervision to the work of research technicians or other laboratory personnel, including training and mentoring of team members.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Ph.D. In life sciences or equivalent combination of education and experience.
A minimum of 6 years of research laboratory experience with at least 3 years in a supervisory/management role.
Experience with mouse husbandry and genetics.
Proven ability to perform highly complex experiments with high levels of reliability and accuracy within time constraints.
Excellent problem-solving skills, adaptability, and high attention to detail.
Excellent organizational, communication, interpersonal, and teamwork skills.
Preferred Requirements
Experience in managing a molecular biology or cellular biology research laboratory.
Ability to initiate and compose communications for various purposes in an appropriate style.
Ability to review goals, analyze processes necessary to achieve those goals, and develop techniques and systems required to meet those goals.

cond_0400.intro:
We are seeking an experienced Senior Lab Manager to join the team of Dr. Catherine Dulac at [Location masked].
The Dulac lab focuses on transcriptional, genetic, and optical approaches to explore the molecular and neuronal basis of instinctive social and sickness behaviors in the mouse. More information about the team and their research can be found at: https://www.dulaclab.com/
The Senior Lab Manager will manage the day-to-day operations of the lab and serve as the primary liaison between the lab and various external partners. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the logic of molecular and neuronal research work.
cond_0400.responsibilities:
Manage day-to-day activities within the laboratory; assure effective operation and maintenance of equipment; obtain and ensure adequate supplies for experimental needs; maintain compliance with all policies and regulations, ensure optimal organization of lab space, contributing to a safe and efficient working environment for all members.
Carry out research projects in collaboration with other lab members. Research activities may involve molecular biology, imaging of neural structures, performing mouse behavioral assays, or surgeries for virus injection or implanting imaging lenses into mouse brains.
Maintain inventories of lab equipment and scientific materials (i.e., probes, antibodies, etc.).
Establish and maintain online documentation system for protocols and equipment manuals/SOPs.
Act as liaison between laboratory, [Company name masked] staff and host institution staff to achieve scientific goals. Coordinate with these groups on projects such as fixed asset inventories, etc.
Manage animal protocols and act as liaison between the laboratory and animal care regulatory offices to ensure compliance with all applicable regulations.
Act as Lab Safety Officer, liaising with [Location masked] Environmental Health & Safety to maintain a safe working environment in the laboratory.
Train incoming personnel in proper lab conduct and may provide instruction regarding experimental protocols. Develop instructional material for routine training purposes.
Maintain lab website.
May plan for and provide working supervision to the work of research technicians or other laboratory personnel, including training and mentoring of team members.
cond_0400.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Ph.D. In life sciences or equivalent combination of education and experience.

Excellent problem-solving skills, adaptability, and high attention to detail.
Excellent organizational, communication, interpersonal, and teamwork skills.

Experience in managing a molecular biology or cellular biology research laboratory.

The lab focuses on transcriptional, genetic, and optical approaches to explore the molecular and neuronal basis of instinctive social and sickness behaviors in the mouse. More information about the team and their research can be found at: https://www.dulaclab.com/
The Senior Lab Manager will be central to managing the day-to-day operations of the lab and will serve as the primary point of contact between the lab and various external partners. A large part of the role involves staying in regular communication with lab members, institutional staff, and external offices. The successful candidate will be organized, proactive, and resourceful, and will be committed to fostering a collaborative, inclusive, and team-oriented environment.
cond_0447.responsibilities:
Manage day-to-day activities within the laboratory; assure effective operation and maintenance of equipment; obtain and ensure adequate supplies for experimental needs; maintain compliance with all policies and regulations; ensure optimal organization of lab space, contributing to a safe and efficient working environment for all members.
Carry out research projects in close collaboration with other lab members, with regular communication throughout. Research activities may involve molecular biology, imaging of neural structures, performing mouse behavioral assays, or surgeries for virus injection or implanting imaging lenses into mouse brains.
Maintain inventories of lab equipment and scientific materials (i.e., probes, antibodies, etc.).
Establish and maintain an online documentation system for protocols and equipment manuals/SOPs.
Act as liaison between the laboratory, [Company name masked] staff, and host institution staff to achieve scientific goals. Actively connect with these groups on projects such as fixed asset inventories, initiating discussions to keep things on track.
Manage animal protocols and act as the ongoing point of contact between the laboratory and animal care regulatory offices to ensure compliance with all applicable regulations.
Act as Lab Safety Officer, staying in regular contact with [Location masked] Environmental Health & Safety to maintain a safe working environment in the laboratory.
Train incoming personnel in proper lab conduct and provide instruction regarding experimental protocols. Develop instructional material for routine training purposes, and be available to answer questions from new team members.
Maintain lab website.
May plan for and provide working supervision to research technicians or other laboratory personnel, including training and mentoring of team members.
cond_0447.requirements:
Ph.D. In life sciences or equivalent combination of education and experience is required.
A minimum of 6 years of research laboratory experience with at least 3 years in a supervisory/management role is required.
Experience in managing a molecular biology or cellular biology research laboratory is preferred.
Proven ability to perform highly complex experiments with high levels of reliability and accuracy within time constraints.
Experience with mouse husbandry and genetics required.
Ability to initiate and compose communications for various purposes in an appropriate style.
Ability to review goals, analyze processes necessary to achieve those goals, and develop techniques and systems required to meet those goals.
Excellent problem-solving skills, adaptability, and high attention to detail.
Excellent organizational, communication, interpersonal, and teamwork skills.

The Dulac lab focuses on transcriptional, genetic, and optical approaches to explore the molecular and neuronal basis of instinctive social and sickness behaviors in the mouse. More information about the team and their research can be found at: https://www.dulaclab.com/
cond_0489.responsibilities:
Manage day-to-day activities within the laboratory; assure effective operation and maintenance of equipment; obtain and ensure adequate supplies for experimental needs; maintain compliance with all policies and regulations, ensure optimal organization of lab space, contributing to a safe and efficient working environment for all members.
Carry out research projects in collaboration with other lab members. Research activities may involve molecular biology, imaging of neural structures, performing mouse behavioral assays, or surgeries for virus injection or implanting imaging lenses into mouse brains.
Maintain inventories of lab equipment and scientific materials (i.e., probes, antibodies, etc.).
Establish and maintain online documentation system for protocols and equipment manuals/SOPs.
Act as liaison between laboratory, [Company name masked] staff and host institution staff to achieve scientific goals. Coordinate with these groups on projects such as fixed asset inventories, etc.
Manage animal protocols and act as liaison between the laboratory and animal care regulatory offices to ensure compliance with all applicable regulations.
Act as Lab Safety Officer, liaising with [Location masked] Environmental Health & Safety to maintain a safe working environment in the laboratory.
Train incoming personnel in proper lab conduct and may provide instruction regarding experimental protocols. Develop instructional material for routine training purposes.
Maintain lab website.
May plan for and provide working supervision to the work of research technicians or other laboratory personnel, including training and mentoring of team members.
cond_0489.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Ph.D. In life sciences, or equivalent practical experience.
Around 6 years of research laboratory experience, with at least 3 years in a supervisory or management role, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
Experience with mouse husbandry and genetics.
Ability to perform complex experiments with reliability and accuracy.
Comfort with reviewing goals, analyzing processes, and developing systems to meet those goals.
Good organizational, communication, interpersonal, and teamwork skills.
Preferred Requirements
Experience managing a molecular biology or cellular biology research laboratory.
Familiarity with composing communications for various purposes in an appropriate style.
Openness to feedback and a willingness to adapt; attention to detail and problem-solving ability.
Please include a cover letter detailing your interest in this position as part of your application.
Physical Requirements:
Remaining in a normal seated or standing position for extended periods of time; reaching and grasping by extending hand(s) or arm(s); dexterity to manipulate objects with fingers, for example using a keyboard; communication skills using the spoken word; ability to see and hear within normal parameters; ability to move about workspace. The position requires mobility, including the ability to move materials weighing up to several pounds (such as a laptop computer or tablet). Work may involve possible exposure to malodorous vapors, low dose radiation, contamination by toxic chemicals and acids and presence of carcinogenic substances.
Persons with disabilities may be able to perform the essential duties of this position with reasonable accommodation. Requests for reasonable accommodation will be evaluated on an individual basis.
Please Note:
This job description sets forth the job's principal duties, responsibilities, and requirements; it should not be construed as an exhaustive statement, however. Unless they begin with the word ""may,"" the Essential Duties and Responsibilities described above are ""essential functions"" of the job, as defined by the Americans with Disabilities Act.

The Dulac lab focuses on transcriptional, genetic, and optical approaches to explore the molecular and neuronal basis of instinctive social and sickness behaviors in the mouse. More information about the team and their research can be found at: https://www.dulaclab.com/
About the Senior Laboratory Manager role:
The Senior Lab Manager will manage the day-to-day operations involved in running the lab, and serve as the primary liaison between the lab and various external partners. The ideal candidate is extremely organized, engaged, proactive and resourceful, and able to multitask. Additionally, the successful candidate will be committed to fostering a collaborative, inclusive and team-oriented environment.
cond_0498.responsibilities:
Manage day-to-day activities within the laboratory; assure effective operation and maintenance of equipment; obtain and ensure adequate supplies for experimental needs; maintain compliance with all policies and regulations, ensure optimal organization of lab space, contributing to a safe and efficient working environment for all members.
Carry out research projects in collaboration with other lab members. Research activities may involve molecular biology, imaging of neural structures, performing mouse behavioral assays, or surgeries for virus injection or implanting imaging lenses into mouse brains.
Maintain inventories of lab equipment and scientific materials (i.e., probes, antibodies, etc.).
Establish and maintain online documentation system for protocols and equipment manuals/SOPs.
Act as liaison between laboratory, [Company name masked] staff and host institution staff to achieve scientific goals. Coordinate with these groups on projects such as fixed asset inventories, etc.
Manage animal protocols and act as liaison between the laboratory and animal care regulatory offices to ensure compliance with all applicable regulations.
Act as Lab Safety Officer, liaising with [Location masked] Environmental Health & Safety to maintain a safe working environment in the laboratory.
Train incoming personnel in proper lab conduct and may provide instruction regarding experimental protocols. Develop instructional material for routine training purposes.
Maintain lab website.
May plan for and provide working supervision to the work of research technicians or other laboratory personnel, including training and mentoring of team members.
cond_0498.requirements:
Ph.D. In life sciences or related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Around 6 years of research laboratory experience, with at least 3 years in a supervisory or management role, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
Experience managing a molecular biology or cellular biology research laboratory is a plus.
Experience performing complex experiments with attention to reliability and accuracy; comfort working within time constraints.
Experience with mouse husbandry and genetics.
Ability to communicate effectively in writing for a range of purposes and audiences.
Ability to review goals, analyze the processes needed to achieve them, and develop practical techniques and systems to meet those goals.
Good problem-solving skills, adaptability, and attention to detail.
Good organizational, communication, interpersonal, and teamwork skills.

The lab focuses on transcriptional, genetic, and optical approaches to explore the molecular and neuronal basis of instinctive social and sickness behaviors in the mouse. More information about the team and their research can be found at: https://www.dulaclab.com/
The Senior Lab Manager will manage the day-to-day operations involved in running the lab and serve as the primary liaison between the lab and various external partners. People usually grow into this role over time as they build experience with lab management and the research environment.
cond_0608.responsibilities:
Manage day-to-day activities within the laboratory; assure effective operation and maintenance of equipment; obtain and ensure adequate supplies for experimental needs; maintain compliance with all policies and regulations, ensure optimal organization of lab space, contributing to a safe and efficient working environment for all members.
Carry out research projects in collaboration with other lab members. Research activities may involve molecular biology, imaging of neural structures, performing mouse behavioral assays, or surgeries for virus injection or implanting imaging lenses into mouse brains.
Maintain inventories of lab equipment and scientific materials (i.e., probes, antibodies, etc.).
Establish and maintain online documentation system for protocols and equipment manuals/SOPs.
Act as liaison between laboratory, [Company name masked] staff and host institution staff to achieve scientific goals. Coordinate with these groups on projects such as fixed asset inventories, etc.
Manage animal protocols and act as liaison between the laboratory and animal care regulatory offices to ensure compliance with all applicable regulations.
Act as Lab Safety Officer, liaising with [Location masked] Environmental Health & Safety to maintain a safe working environment in the laboratory.
Train incoming personnel in proper lab conduct and may provide instruction regarding experimental protocols. Develop instructional material for routine training purposes.
Maintain lab website.
May plan for and provide working supervision to the work of research technicians or other laboratory personnel, including training and mentoring of team members.
cond_0608.requirements:
Ph.D. In life sciences or equivalent combination of education and experience is required.
A minimum of 6 years of research laboratory experience with at least 3 years in a supervisory/management role is required.
Experience in managing a molecular biology or cellular biology research laboratory is preferred.
Proven ability to perform highly complex experiments with high levels of reliability and accuracy within time constraints.
Experience with mouse husbandry and genetics required.
Ability to initiate and compose communications for various purposes in an appropriate style.
Ability to review goals, analyze processes necessary to achieve those goals, and develop techniques and systems required to meet those goals.
Excellent problem-solving skills, adaptability, and high attention to detail.
Excellent organizational, communication, interpersonal, and teamwork skills.
Please include a cover letter detailing your interest in this position as part of your application.
Physical Requirements:
Remaining in a normal seated or standing position for extended periods of time; reaching and grasping by extending hand(s) or arm(s); dexterity to manipulate objects with fingers, for example using a keyboard; communication skills using the spoken word; ability to see and hear within normal parameters; ability to move about workspace. The position requires mobility, including the ability to move materials weighing up to several pounds (such as a laptop computer or tablet). Work may involve possible exposure to malodorous vapors, low dose radiation, contamination by toxic chemicals and acids and presence of carcinogenic substances.
Persons with disabilities may be able to perform the essential duties of this position with reasonable accommodation. Requests for reasonable accommodation will be evaluated on an individual basis.
